Be Supposed to in Negative Statements
You use be supposed to when you have to do something or it is an obligation.
This weakness is not supposed to be introduced for the product developer but it is important to identify it and fix it as soon as possible in order to decrease the system information assurance.
The attacker is not supposed to control and cause the server to fail, it should be a risk for security vulnerability.
The attacker is not supposed to modify any of the elements of the products without authorization.

In affirmative statements, you use be supposed to to express something that is intended to happen or ti imply a similar in meaning to “It is said”

Example:
Companies are supposed to know how to protect themselves from attackers who can access their information.

In negative statements, you use be not supposed to for something that is not allowed or basically prohibited. You use the verb to be form in singular or plural when corresponding.

Example:
The product is not supposed to have flaws and defects.
The attackers are not supposed to control the software.
Modal Verbs for What is Advisable
You use modal verbs like ought to and should to give advice and make suggestions.
The concept of vulnerability should not be confused with everything that causes an attack against the system.
When there is vulnerability with risk, the company ought to protect the data and avoid the security defects.

A piece of advice might be also known as an opinion or recommendation. These modal verbs (should and ought to) connote the idea of conducting or guiding.

In software some suggestions must be followed in order to avoid fraud, flaws or defects in a product.

In affirmative statements, the use of should and ought to give advice in a polite way an be interchagable; however, there is a slight difference between both modals; should implies a subjective point of view while ought to is used for objective statements, such as laws or regulations.

Example:
In the company, you should identify the security holes in order to protect your company and your employees.
You ought to protect your personal information.

images.text: • In computer science, there is an issue called vulnerability that affects the software security industry. A product is considered vulnerable when it has a security exposure; this means a weakness. This weakness is not supposed to be introduced by the product developer, but it is important to identify it and fix it as soon as possible in order to decrease the system information assurance. In fact, the one who spots a product weakness is called an attacker, a person who gets into the system by doing so. However, the concept of vulnerability should not be confused with anything that causes an attack against the system because in some cases it refers to bad user's usage of the product.

• Whenever a weakness is detected in a product, it compromises aspects like the availability, integrity, or confidentiality of a product. Availability refers to the capacity to access a product or resource; in other words, the attacker is not supposed to control and cause the server to fail. The system should be able to detect and block this action on time. On the other hand, integrity refers to trustfulness; the attacker is not supposed to modify any of the elements of the product without authorization. Plus, another goal for security is confidentiality, which refers to limiting the access of the information that must be kept in private. All in all, the attacker is not supposed to compromise any of the data within the product.

• If an organization is established, it should know that vulnerability has two possibilities: with risks and without risks. Risk can be understood as a chance of loss. When there is vulnerability with risk, the company ought to protect the data and avoid the security defects. However, when there is vulnerability without risk, it means that the defect was already fixed or removed. Anyway, the company ought to find the way to disable the attacker as fast as possible.
